name: bible-expert
description: Study Bible passages, biblical vocabulary and reading plans in every Bible Expert app language, then continue learning in the app.

interface.longDescription: Read source-based Bible passages, explore biblical vocabulary and choose existing reading plans in all 17 Bible Expert app locales, including simplified and traditional Chinese. Study in ChatGPT, then download Bible Expert to read in chapter context and track reading progress. Editions disclose their rights, available books and missing verse text. No account is needed. ChatGPT studies are not imported into app notes.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose a short Bible reading plan.
What does grace mean in the Bible?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: Bible study in all 17 app locales with reviewed Bible editions, glossary entries and existing reading plans, plus optional app download and exact-passage or same-plan continuation.

positive.expected_behavior: Quote the exact Segond 1910 text, answer fully in French and offer one contextual study card for the same reference.

positive.prompt: Help me understand Psalm 23 in the World English Bible.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve edition 206 without changing its text, explain the chapter and offer the matching app continuation.

positive.prompt: Que signifie la grâce dans la Bible ?
positive.expected_behavior: Find the published French glossary entry, attribute it and distinguish the glossary from additional interpretation.

positive.description: Find an existing short reading plan
positive.prompt: Help me choose a Bible reading plan that takes no more than seven days.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply max_days=7, suggest a real matching plan and show its download/open card without subscribing the user.

positive.prompt: Show me the Gospel of John in 21 days plan.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the existing john-21-days schedule and a same-plan card; explain native progress and reminders without importing ChatGPT content.

negative.prompt: Save this ChatGPT study in my Bible Expert notes.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that conversation and note import are unavailable; do not claim that anything was saved or call a write tool.

negative.prompt: Quote John 3:16 from the NIV using Bible Expert.
negative.expected_behavior: Call list_bible_editions and explain the reviewed editions available for that language; do not misattribute a quotation or silently change language.

negative.prompt: Explain John 3:16 but do not suggest installing any app.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer using the retrieved passage and omit show_study_card and download promotion.
